name: Hardened steel brigandine with shoulder guards
description: A canvas vest lined with rows of hardened steel plates riveted through the cloth, buckled shut down the front, with a guard of overlapping hardened steel lames strapped over each shoulder. It fits over mail.
notes: Shares the mild steel model; its rivet heads and shoulder lames take `steel-hardened`. Slot vest: it is worn as the outer armour layer over a shirt or mail, as the stab vest is. No attach points: its shoulder guards are built in. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.

name: Hardened steel brigandine coat
description: A long canvas coat lined with rows of hardened steel plates riveted through the cloth from collar to mid-thigh, its skirt split at the front for walking. It fits over mail.
notes: Shares the mild steel model; its rivet heads take `steel-hardened`. Slot vest: it is worn as the outer armour layer over a shirt or mail, as the stab vest is. Attach points: left and right shoulder are the laced points on the leather strap over the top of each front half, beside the neck opening, where shoulder guards mount. The xl and xs sizes share the model. The worn look is pending: clothing gets inventory and ground models only until a fitted worn family exists.
